_comment: T-332 Hollowed Crypt boss 3 — Maldrath the Unhallowed, the Hollow King (graduation test). Instance-scoped at the_vault anchor. Reuses the T-341 skeletal-warrior mesh via render_kind at render_scale 1.6 (he TOWERS); mob_id 'mob_crypt_maldrath' is the unique kill-credit / T-333 loot alias. Mechanic beyond enrage: a PHASE-2 flip at 50% HP — the T-294 enrage fires automatically (enrage_threshold 0.5 on the existing swing path) AND the periodic restless-shade summons speed up (mechanic_cadence 400 -> phase2_cadence 200), capped at max_adds. The full-party test: enrage + adds + a big health pool.
lore: T-344 (era-direction.md S2): Maldrath is not merely a wight among the risen — he is patient zero. In the deepest Vault, the old village walled in the first body the Hollowing ever took. Killing him seals this outbreak; it does not end what began here.
name: Maldrath the Unhallowed
